as_told.title: Grey Fox/ISA and JSOC in UFO crash retrieval

plain: Recovering crashed UFOs is said to be handled by the CIA's OGA, short for "other government agency", created in 2002, together with JSOC, the Joint Special Operations Command that runs the US military's elite special forces. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says this, citing reporting by a man named Chris Sharp and others. Michels says the UFO crash retrieval program is rumoured to work closely with JSOC, and names a secretive unit called Grey Fox, or ISA, as part of it. If true, it would mean special forces units are the ones picking up crashed craft.
